records.text: Turning Point USA employees said the organization had been behind attacks against Candace Owens from the beginning
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #5 (Ep 1IY2oD-_xVA)

appearances.snippet: But what I will say is I found out from employees that they were behind the attacks against me from the very beginning.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. The allegation relies on unnamed former employees and supplies no records or attributable evidence establishing that Turning Point USA organized attacks on Owens.

conveyance.original_source: private reports from Turning Point USA employees
